subject: Has anyone been able to install rattle with R.3.0.x and Mountain Lion ?????

messages.author: 027e86e2d7290ed1
messages.subject: Has anyone been able to install rattle with R.3.0.x and Mountain Lion ?????
parts:
There are several posts on this topic but have not seen that anyone has solved this.

I installed Xquartz, then R 3.0.2.  Installed RGtk2 without any complaints from GUI. Downloaded rattle package which installed just fine.

When I ran rattle() was asked to install GTK+ which I did.  It installed fine.

Exited and restarted R, loaded the rattle library, executed crv$rattleUI <- "rattle_macosx.ui".

Then ......
> rattle()
Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) : 
  unable to load shared object '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/RGtk2/libs/RGtk2.so':
  dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/RGtk2/libs/RGtk2.so, 6): Library not loaded: /Library/Frameworks/GTK+.framework/Versions/2.24.X11/Resources/lib/libgtk-x11-2.0.0.dylib
  Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/RGtk2/libs/RGtk2.so
  Reason: image not found
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'RGtk2', details:
  call: if (choice == 1) {
  error: argument is of length zero
In addition: Warning message:
Failed to load RGtk2 dynamic library, attempting to install it. 
Error in rattle() : could not find function "gtkBuilderNew"


It appears as though R does not see GTK+.  Perhaps the PATH environment variable is not correct but I lack the expertise to verify or correct. 

Guess rattle on Mac is a no go until the Mac-GTK+_quartz build is worked out .....

I have made one discovery but the end result still eludes.  

1) When RGtk2 load GTK+ it loads the build for R2.15.  If you go to the att page [http://r.research.att.com/#other] there is a different build for R3.0 - Snow leopard.  I installed with the 2.24.17.

Now R reckognizes GTK+ but crashes when it builds a window!

messages.author: 027e86e2d7290ed1
messages.subject: Re: Has anyone been able to install rattle with R.3.0.x and Mountain Lion ?????
parts:
Perhaps I am answering my own question but others may benefit.

Check out: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/15868860/r-3-0-and-gtk-rgtk2-error

There seems to be a problem in the GTK+ builds and R3.0.  The stackflow thread talks about solving by installing from ?source via home-brew or macports.

This is well over my head but am sure eventually a simpler approach will become available.   Until then, rattle on Mac will have to wait.

Bob

p.s. rattle is worth waiting for :-)
